heading: Confession to police-officer not to be proved.
text: No confession made to a police-officer[3], shall be proved as against a person accused of any offence.
status_note: The Act is repealed. Kept in India Code's 'Repeal Acts' collection; record title reads 'The Indian Evidence Act, 1872, 1 of 1872 (Rep., Act 47 of 2023)' (read 2026-11-21)
notes: As to statements made to police-officer investigating a case, see s. 162, ibid (w.e.f. 1-4-1974).
